newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tottori Bank to list shares on Dec 13-Osaka bourse.
newsitem.headline: Tottori Bank to list shares on Dec 13-Osaka bourse.

text.p: The Osaka Securities Exchange (OSE) said on Friday that shares in Tottori Bank Ltd would be listed on the OSE's second section and on the Hiroshima stock exchange on December 13.
The regional bank, based in western Japan, had deposits totalling 582.19 billion yen at the end of last business year on March 31.
It expects to post pretax profits of 21.9 billion yen in the current business year, ending next March 31, down from 24.58 billion yen in the previous year.
The bank's bad loans totalled 5.13 billion yen as of March 31.
Sanwa Bank Ltd, a major commercial Japanese bank, held a 4.5 percent stake in Tottori Bank as of March 31.
